newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at new high, boosted by Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at new high, boosted by Astra.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket closed at a new high on Thursday, ignoring losses in New York and led up by drugs major Astra.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.83 percent to 2,324.07 after a fairly active day in which shares worth 5.26 billion crowns changed hands.

The focus of the day was drugs major Astra which rose to a new intra-day high of 339 crowns before ending nine crowns higher at 336.5 crowns. Brokers attributed the rise to a plethora of rumours including Investor selling its Astra stake and links with Swiss rival Roche.
Astra drove the drugs sector index up 2.39 percent.
Investor, which declined to comment on the rumours, rose 5.5 crowns to 284.5 crowns, pulling the investment sector index up 1.44 percent.
Another strong performer was Volvo which closed 7.5 crowns up at 155 crowns. Brokers said this was due to the strong car sector in the U.S..
Telecoms giant Ericsson slipped 1.5 to 203.5 crowns.
